audio.linha: Write one line about the audio: it is how people who can't listen follow along.

transcricao.dica: Others only see it after you approve it. Until then, it stays on this screen.
transcricao.origemAparelho: Dictated on the device and reviewed by the person who recorded it
transcricao.origemDigitada: Written by the person who recorded it

video.limite: Up to {s} seconds. It stays in the post, with the same rule for who can see it.
video.descricaoDica: Describe what is shown, for people who can't see it. Avoid naming anyone who doesn't want to appear.
video.limpo: Re-recorded on this device: the new file carries no location, camera model or date.
video.tirarDoPost: Remove the video from the post
video.confirmarTirar: Remove the video from this post? The file is deleted for good.
video.esperando: The video is still being prepared. Wait for it to finish before publishing.
video.umTipo: A post carries photos, audio or video, one at a time. Remove the photos or the audio to publish with the video.
video.resposta: Video only in posts, not in replies.
video.naoEntrou: The post went out, but the video didn't: {erro}

erros.desligado: Video in posts isn't turned on yet.
erros.midia_cheia: Your media space is full. Delete old photos or videos to upload another.
erros.grande: The video got too big. Choose a shorter clip or turn the sound off.
erros.longo: The video is longer than 60 seconds.
erros.tipo: This file isn't a video Alumia accepts (MP4 or WEBM).
erros.invalido: Something in the request doesn't match. Try again.
erros.invalida: This video couldn't be opened on this device.
erros.sem_gravador: This browser can't prepare the video. Try another browser.
erros.tarde: It's too late to add a video to this post (15 minutes after publishing).
erros.dado_pessoal: The text has personal data (ID number, phone, e-mail or street address with number). Remove it and try again.
erros.revisar: This text didn't pass Alumia's check. Review it and try again; if it keeps happening, talk to the mediators.
erros.muitos_pedidos: Too many uploads in a short time. Wait a little.
erros.sem_ditado: The device stopped transcribing. You can keep typing.
